# Kraki for Mac 0.2.91
- Fixed agents losing access to Documents, Desktop and other protected folders ("Operation not permitted") after an app update. Kraki now restarts its background service when an update replaces it, so Full Disk Access keeps working without restarting Kraki yourself. - Long chat histories fill the window without needing a scroll first, and live action cards refresh when their content changes. - After first setup, Kraki offers to connect your phone right away.

# Kraki for Mac 0.2.90
- Opening a Session with a red dot lands on the start of the latest reply again, when the reply is longer than a screen. - Your GitHub avatar loads from GitHub's image server directly, so it also shows on networks where github.com is unreachable.

# Kraki for Mac 0.2.89
- Images load faster. Several images now download together when your connection is fast. On a slow connection images still load one piece at a time, so chat stays responsive. - You can open an image before it has finished loading. The viewer shows its progress and the picture appears in place when it arrives. - When a message has several images, you can page through all of them in the viewer, including ones that are still loading. - When the agent asks a question while other tools are still running, the chat shows only the question. Before, a second "tools running" bubble appeared under it. - Sidebar search also matches the start of a Session ID, and ignores accents.
